_comment: Star Wars collection. Each name in 'lines' brings in its WHOLE evolutionary line. The 18 lines were picked with `generate.py pick --count 18 --seed star-wars-galaxy` (lines may be shared with other collections since #24), then given a look each (three lines per look). Shared look in styles/_galaxy.py.

readme.title: Star Wars
readme.summary: Pokemon from a galaxy far, far away (inspired by Star Wars; original patterns).
looks: each line wears one look: a Jedi tunic and robe with a blue blade (Chimchar, Mudkip, Pansage); a Sith robe with a red blade and red eyes (Munkidori, Inkay, Spinarak); white trooper armour (Miltank, Wobbuffet, Spritzee); polished beskar plates with a dark visor (Palkia, Tornadus, Greavard); an astromech droid shell with blinking lights (Toxel, Grimer, Ledyba); an orange rebel flight suit (Bulbasaur, Noibat, Comfey)
the blades hum and the droid lights blink in the dark
shiny: the other side: a green blade, a purple blade, black shadow armour, gold beskar, red panels, a green suit
